Name: CP - Even cuter farmer characters
Author: OneCubic
Description:
[size=5]修改过的鞋子，裤子，侧身角度，眼影。添加脸红。取消泳衣。增添更多选项。
PS：只有女农夫是没有泳装的，因为我不会画，原版的又太丑了，所以……请看标签:0【现在有泳装了，在可选文件里】

Modified shoes, pants, side stance Angle, eye shadow. Added blush.Cancel swimwear.Add more options.
PS: Only female farmers don't have swimsuits because I can't draw and the original ones are too ugly, so... Look at the tag :0[There are swimsuits now, in the optional file]

[/size]
[size=4][color=#ff7700]女农默认腮红+白袜子+长袖+鞋分开的体型
男农默认长袖+靴子的体型
assets文件夹里有一个【可选】的文件夹，打开之后选择你想要替换的版本，然后删除【括号里的内容包括括号】拖到assets文件夹里替换，替换之前可以选择对源文件备份或者不备份，之后替换了就可以进游戏了。

The female farmer defaults to the body type of blush + white socks + long sleeves + shoes separated
The male farmer defaults to the body type of long sleeves + boots
There is an 【Optional】folder in the assets folder, open it and select the version you want to replace, 【then delete the content in the brackets including parentheses】 and drag it to the assets folder to replace it, you can choose to back up the source file or not to back it up before replacing, and then you can enter the game after replacement.[/color]

[/size][color=#ff00ff][size=4]我还在研究怎么用通用菜单在游戏里选择选项，好吧。。。我是笨蛋，只能委屈你们自己手动在游戏外替换自己喜欢的了。T_T
I'm still working on how to use the Generic Mod Config Menu to select options in the game, okay... I'm stupid, so I can only ask you to manually replace your favorite ones outside the game.T_T[/size][/color]
